description: Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Jaffna and the University of Bristol in the United Kingdom
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Jaffna and the University of Bristol in the United Kingdom, with a view to promoting educational corporation within the higher education sector, was approved by the Cabinet.
